title: Understanding Principal Components
text: The first two principal components (PC1 and PC2) help us understand the main directions of variance in the data. Look at how the different exhibits contribute to these components in the plots of the first and second rows of $$V^T$$.

title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: The scatterplot shows three distinct groups of visitors. Consider how the contributions of different exhibits to PC1 and PC2 might influence the positioning of these groups.

hintAnswer: These visitors spend a lot of time at the mammal exhibits (cheetah, tiger, and lion).
title: Focus on the Bottom-Left Group
text: Which exhibits have the highest positive contributions to PC1 and PC2 for the bottom-left group?
choices: These visitors spend a lot of time at the mammal exhibits (cheetah, tiger, and lion).
